extName.message: PiP Viewer — Picture-in-Picture for video & images

extDesc.message: Open any video, image or canvas in a picture-in-picture window that floats above every app.

cmdTogglePip.message: Toggle picture-in-picture for the playing video

cmdPickElement.message: Pick an element to open in PiP

cmdPipImage.message: Open PiP for the largest image on the page

menuPage.message: PiP the video playing on this page

menuPick.message: Pick an element to open in PiP…

popupNoVideo.message: No video found — you can still open an image in PiP

popupPro.message: PiP Viewer Pro — in-window controls, subtitles, screenshots and clips

optHoverButton.message: Show a PiP button when hovering a video

optAutoPiP.message: Turn on PiP when you switch tabs

dashLede.message: Every change saves immediately and applies to open tabs.

hoverBtnDesc.message: A small button appears in the corner of the video; one click opens PiP.

hoverPosDesc.message: Which corner of the video it sits in.

minWidthDesc.message: Narrower videos get no button — keeps ads and thumbnails out of the way.

autoPiPDesc.message: The playing video floats up on its own when you leave the tab.

exitOnReturn.message: Exit PiP when you come back

exitOnReturnDesc.message: Puts the video back exactly where it was on the page.

pauseOnExit.message: Pause the video when PiP closes

pauseOnExitDesc.message: By default the video keeps playing on the page after PiP closes.

showToastDesc.message: A note at the bottom of the page when PiP opens or something fails.

imageModeDesc.message: Images are drawn to a canvas and played as video, so they float above every window.

floatWidthDesc.message: Used for the in-page floating window when the browser has no real PiP.

sitesDesc.message: On these sites PiP Viewer shows no hover button and never turns PiP on by itself. You can still open PiP by hand with a shortcut or the right-click menu. Enter a domain such as example.com — subdomains count too.

keyToggleDesc.message: Toggle PiP for the playing video

keyPickDesc.message: Pick an element on the page to open in PiP

keyImageDesc.message: Open PiP for the largest image on the page

keysHint.message: Open {url} manually to change the shortcuts.

proHead.message: The free version is enough for everyday use.

proSub.message: Pro adds the parts that take real upkeep — buy once, keep it.

featControls.message: Controls inside the PiP window (seek, speed, volume)

featSubs.message: Subtitles shown inside the PiP window

featCapture.message: Grab a frame, record the part you are watching

featSrt.message: Drag a local .srt file onto the window

featFrame.message: Step frame by frame while paused

proHint.message: No payment needed to use it — the free version never expires.

statUnsupportedFloat.message: Not supported — falls back to a floating window

aboutUsage.message: How to use it: click the extension icon for quick actions, right-click a video or image to open PiP, or use Pick element and click any video, image or canvas.

resetDesc.message: Clears every customisation, including the excluded sites.

resetConfirm.message: Reset all settings to their defaults?

noVideo.message: No video found on this page

cannotPiPVideo.message: Cannot open PiP for this video

fallbackFloat.message: This browser has no native PiP — using an in-page floating window

cannotPiPElement.message: Cannot open PiP for this element

notMedia.message: That element is not a video or an image

pickerTip.message: Click a video or image to open PiP — Esc to cancel
